paragraphs: Mes Bisous is a brand dedicated to your self-discovery about seduction. As the unbreakable connection between memories and scents is made in the human brain, each perfume is crafted to evoke and invigorate different ways of your being.

Discovering the lasting effects of perfumes on one’s emotions happened to our founder Buse at an early age. A visit to an essential oil atelier in Egypt when she was 8 changed her forever. Years passed, and she became a successful lawyer; then she quit her profession and devoted her life to the passion that has always been there: perfumes.
Comprised of a hand-embroidered box with unique illustrations, a poem and a story, each of her designs is a work of art.
timeline: An essential oil atelier in Egypt felt like magic
A successful career, left to follow her heart
Nine stories, each a work of art
From Istanbul and Milan to Doha, Lagos and Atlanta

products.description: We sailed without a plan. / Just you, me & the sea. / Ice in our drinks, salt on the lip, / A frozen dream upon a golden ship. / No drama promised, no maps to reach, / Far from the world, / Far from the beach. / A cold sweetness that never ends— / Where the azure begins, / And the story melts.
